environment.device: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit
environment.claim_scope: one fixed-clock Orin; synthetic canonical exact-C512 Down P0; no whole-model or production claim

shape_and_layout.scale_application: FP32 cuBLASLt alpha after BF16 direct dequantization

candidate.inclusive_timing: every measured iteration enqueues both ordered operations on the same stream

baseline.identity: current public exact-C512 production Down dispatcher
baseline.selected_kernel: production M128 N128 K64 B-reuse Down specialization <4U>

protocol.performance_gate_is_soft: a speed miss reports REJECT while correctness failures fail CTest

correctness.scale_zero: bitwise exact diagnostic, but selector retains production route
correctness.scale_nan: production invalid-value status before enqueue and zero captured nodes

independent_review.alignment_finding: fixed by setting A/B/C/D minimum alignment preferences to 16 bytes and rerunning
independent_review.graph_finding: fixed by requiring exactly two nodes and rerunning
independent_review.remaining_contract_finding: candidate has no production launcher validator yet; null, near-miss shape, alias, range-wrap, +inf, and wrong-device zero-node gates remain required before integration

decision.why: the inclusive candidate is exact for this P0, beats the live production M128 baseline in all six rounds, and exceeds the 1.22x retention gate with zero Lt workspace
decision.scratch_reuse: the existing exact-C512 Gate/Up 170 MiB request scratch has the identical element count and can be overwritten after SiLU once a production Down module is admitted
next_steps: remove or justify the 64-byte-per-thread dequant local spill and rescreen
replicate across an independent process and additional finite input distributions
add an independent Down context/descriptor/algorithm and complete fail-closed launcher validation
integrate exact C512 only without changing C256, finish-Prefill, Decode, or MTP
run pinned-checkpoint B-C-C-B, Nsight route attribution, full suite, and Decode non-regression

limitations: This is a synthetic test-only P0 ceiling, not a production or whole-Prefill result.
The dequant kernel spills 64 bytes of local storage per thread; production hardening should screen a bounded no-spill windowed decoder.
Only part of the proposed invalid-input selector contract is tested here; the full contract belongs in a production module test.
The hybrid candidate still writes and rereads a 170 MiB BF16 weight image and is not the final fused native NVFP4 large-M upper bound.
